sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Called the Garguile by the French people, the Gar-Ghoul terrorized France until its Amulet was hidden in Rouen in the Cave of the Gargoyle, guarded by a giant Gargoyle statue. Many stone statues were built in its likeness around France and on the Cathedral of Notre Dame to ward off evil spirits. [Into the River of Secrets]

Centuries later, Gar-Ghoul began to awaken, its powers causing mysterious waterspouts and whirlpools to occur on the Seine River, capsizing boats and almost drowning people. Both the Huntik Foundation and the Organization began searching for the Titan, leading them to the Cave of the Gargoyle where the two sides fought. Using the battle as a distraction, DeFoe managed to obtain Gar-Ghoul's Amulet in and invoked it in battle against Dante Vale. However, Gar-Ghoul was defeated by Caliban and called back to its Amulet by DeFoe who fled. [Into the River of Secrets].

In the Abandoned church in Paris, DeFoe summoned Gar-Ghoul to fight against Dante's Caliban once more, but althoughGar-Ghoul still could not beat Caliban in battle, the two fought on a more even footing. [Crawling the Catacombs]

Gar-Ghoul was used by DeFoe alongside Kreutalk at King Basilisk's resting place to battle against the Huntik team for King Basilisk's amulet. Kreutalk severely weakened Sabriel and Freelancer, making room for Gar-Ghoul to take out Freelancer and presumably also Sabriel. DeFoe made Gar-Ghoul go back to its amulet when Zhalia Moon managed to invoke the powerful King Basilisk. [Absent Heroes]

Inside one of the Argonaut's ship, DeFoe summoned Gar-Ghoul alongside Mindrone. Gar-Ghoul fought against Dante and his Solwing Titan but was defeated by Dante, who used Dragonfist to knock Gar-Ghoul into a hole in the ship. [The Treasures of the Argonauts]

After DeFoe was removed from the Organization, Zhalia Moon took ownership of Gar-Ghoul, although she did not reveal this action until the final battle against the Professor. In that battle, it brought Nordrake out of the air and distracted Tao for a while until being defeated alongside Ariel [The Mission].

Zhalia invoked Gar-Ghoul to fight alongside Dante's Elf King Oberon against Wilder and his team. Gar-Ghoul was defeated by Myrmidon after being hit by a Weakenshade spell cast by Wilder. [Doorway to Huntik]

Zhalia used Gar-Ghoul again when the Huntik team faced Lucas Casterwill, Lane and Dellix at a Casterwill Library. [Chasing Void]

sections.heading: Abilities
sections.wikitext: Some argue that the fear Gar-Ghoul instills is alone enough to win a battle. He has the ability to manipulate water, drawing water from the air into his throat and projecting it as an extremely high-pressure blast of water from his mouth is his signature attack, which could even knock [[Nordrake]] out of the air. Gar-Ghoul's special ability of Aggression makes him so fierce that when he is the one to initiate a fight he cannot be defeated, he may not be the one to win in a battle, but he certainly cannot be beaten easily. And his teeth, claws and powerful tail are also not to be taken lightly, and he was a perfect match for his old master, DeFoe, as well as his new Seeker, Zhalia.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.wikitext:
* Its summoning commands are '''"Manifest'''," "'''Teach them a lesson'''," and "'''Punish them'''."
* Gar-Ghoul's ability to manipulate and spit water is in line with the legends that say that it could drink rivers dry within hours. The old French legend about [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gargoyle Gar-Ghoul]'s namesake describe it as being a great serpent or massive dragon. It gets its name from the old French word ''garguile'' which means "to gurgle."
* Gar-Ghoul has the basic design of a classic modern gargoyle. Other Gargoyle Titans include [[Cherit]] and [[Impet]].
* A large animatronic statue of Gar-Ghoul is featured on the ''[[Yucatan]]'' Spill water ride at ''Rainbow Magicland''. In keeping with its abilities, the statue projects water.

full_text:
Gar-Ghoul is a powerful and fearsome Titan and was the basis for the gargoyle statues and legends of France. As Gar-Ghoul could strike fear into other evil creatures, statues imitating Gar-Ghoul were built and placed on many French buildings to ward off evil spirits.

History

Called the Garguile by the French people, the Gar-Ghoul terrorized France until its Amulet was hidden in Rouen in the Cave of the Gargoyle, guarded by a giant Gargoyle statue. Many stone statues were built in its likeness around France and on the Cathedral of Notre Dame to ward off evil spirits. [Into the River of Secrets]

Centuries later, Gar-Ghoul began to awaken, its powers causing mysterious waterspouts and whirlpools to occur on the Seine River, capsizing boats and almost drowning people. Both the Huntik Foundation and the Organization began searching for the Titan, leading them to the Cave of the Gargoyle where the two sides fought. Using the battle as a distraction, DeFoe managed to obtain Gar-Ghoul's Amulet in and invoked it in battle against Dante Vale. However, Gar-Ghoul was defeated by Caliban and called back to its Amulet by DeFoe who fled. [Into the River of Secrets].

In the Abandoned church in Paris, DeFoe summoned Gar-Ghoul to fight against Dante's Caliban once more, but althoughGar-Ghoul still could not beat Caliban in battle, the two fought on a more even footing. [Crawling the Catacombs]

Gar-Ghoul was used by DeFoe alongside Kreutalk at King Basilisk's resting place to battle against the Huntik team for King Basilisk's amulet. Kreutalk severely weakened Sabriel and Freelancer, making room for Gar-Ghoul to take out Freelancer and presumably also Sabriel. DeFoe made Gar-Ghoul go back to its amulet when Zhalia Moon managed to invoke the powerful King Basilisk. [Absent Heroes]

Inside one of the Argonaut's ship, DeFoe summoned Gar-Ghoul alongside Mindrone. Gar-Ghoul fought against Dante and his Solwing Titan but was defeated by Dante, who used Dragonfist to knock Gar-Ghoul into a hole in the ship. [The Treasures of the Argonauts]

After DeFoe was removed from the Organization, Zhalia Moon took ownership of Gar-Ghoul, although she did not reveal this action until the final battle against the Professor. In that battle, it brought Nordrake out of the air and distracted Tao for a while until being defeated alongside Ariel [The Mission].

Zhalia invoked Gar-Ghoul to fight alongside Dante's Elf King Oberon against Wilder and his team. Gar-Ghoul was defeated by Myrmidon after being hit by a Weakenshade spell cast by Wilder. [Doorway to Huntik]

Zhalia used Gar-Ghoul again when the Huntik team faced Lucas Casterwill, Lane and Dellix at a Casterwill Library. [Chasing Void]

Abilities

Some argue that the fear Gar-Ghoul instills is alone enough to win a battle. He has the ability to manipulate water, drawing water from the air into his throat and projecting it as an extremely high-pressure blast of water from his mouth is his signature attack, which could even knock Nordrake out of the air. Gar-Ghoul's special ability of Aggression makes him so fierce that when he is the one to initiate a fight he cannot be defeated, he may not be the one to win in a battle, but he certainly cannot be beaten easily. And his teeth, claws and powerful tail are also not to be taken lightly, and he was a perfect match for his old master, DeFoe, as well as his new Seeker, Zhalia.
